about: A self-hosted server for TRMNL e-ink displays, with support for shared plugin recipes.

prs.title: Plugin request headers survive import and export
prs.broken: Importing a shared plugin merged all its request headers into one and broke passwords and tokens ending in "=". Exporting also changed web addresses inside the plugin.
prs.changed: Headers are now split and joined the right way in both directions.
prs.matters: Shared plugins that need a login keep working after import, and export gives back the same plugin.
